name: collabosm
description: Run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B-A6B MoE, hybrid Gated-DeltaNet + full attention) on ONE Colab A100-80GB High-RAM, via ExLlamaV3 with Q4 KV, MTP speculative decoding and a pinned-RAM second-tier KV page cache.

verified_on.cu_per_hour_source: Colab /tun/m/ccu-info consumptionRateHourly, box as the only assignment, 2026-09-25 (earlier notes: 7.52)
verified_on.note: mts: the HIGH_RAM shape is NOT what `colab new --gpu A100` returns. See scripts/restore.py.

recipes: recipes.json (resolved by scripts/recipe.py; RECIPE=<id> bash scripts/up.sh)

model.measured_download_note: ~380 MB/s anonymous from HF; the same 100 GiB took 4 min 40 s

ngram_table.note: the PLE/n-gram table. ExLlamaV3 keeps it in HOST RAM via -ngr; it is what makes a 100 GiB pack fit on one 80 GB card.

wheel.note: Prebuilt. NO compile step. The wheel is ABI-bound to (python, torch, cuda), so scripts/bootstrap.sh probes the image and builds the URL from this ABI.

source.note: Fallback only. Compiling costs metered minutes; the wheel is the default.

measured.note: All figures measured on the box above. Prefill prompts were synthetic filler; see docs/MEASURED.md for the provenance and the caveats.

warm_cache_restore.note: speedup is against the -ccs 0 re-prefill; cold_s also paid the one-time kernel autotune

live_endpoint_verified.note: api_server.py enforces the bearer key from /content/api-key.txt. The pack's template has thinking on by default (max_tokens below ~1K then returns a truncated reasoning trace); api_server.py now sends enable_thinking=false unless a request asks for thinking. The tunnel is a Cloudflare quick tunnel, so the hostname is ephemeral.

vram_fit.note: fitted at load with one live job; the measured slope is ~17% above nominal bytes_per_token

capacity.safe_joint_context_tokens: 600000-700000, because prefill staging grows during a real request
capacity.note: The VRAM page pool size is a load-time decision and the -ccs tier is evict-only, so host RAM cannot extend joint live context or live slot count; it only raises the number of warm parked conversations.
